summary.text: Brent Burdge is the Republican candidate for Delaware State Senate District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Shay Frisby and Carolyn Frank of the Independent Party of Delaware in a race with no incumbent.
A chemical engineer, he has run for the House and Senate in earlier elections.

paragraphs.text: Brent Burdge was born in Wichita, Kansas, graduated from Goddard High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 1979.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as chemical engineer.
Burdge ran for Delaware House of Representatives District 10 in 2022, losing to incumbent Sean Matthews, and again in 2024, losing to Melanie Ross Levin.
In the February 15, 2025 special general election for State Senate District 5, Raymond Seigfried defeated Burdge 64.9% to 34.6%.
